name_subsets: every font but Essential also holds the characters of its own family name, copied from NotoSans with the character map alone (the rows of fonts whose subset is "name"): the one exception to each character in one font
sources: https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io at 4cf78353cd1668040ba8efa13029cd910fcdf9e2 (static Noto fonts); https://github.com/google/fonts at c30b221beb0c1da59d563feb91ec8656a1fa972a (Noto Sans JP, KR, SC, and Noto Emoji: the variable TrueType builds, instanced at Regular); Noto Serif Dives Akuru 1.001 from its project's release (https://github.com/notofonts/dives-akuru/releases/download/NotoSerifDivesAkuru-v1.001/NotoSerifDivesAkuru-v1.001.zip); for the characters and scripts no Noto font has, pinned releases of SIL's Andika 7.000 (https://github.com/silnrsi/font-andika/releases/download/v7.000/Andika-7.000.zip), Kanchenjunga 2.001 (https://github.com/silnrsi/font-kanchenjunga/releases/download/v2.001/Kanchenjunga-2.001.zip), Kedebideri 3.001 (https://github.com/silnrsi/font-kedebideri/releases/download/v3.001/Kedebideri-3.001.zip), and Padauk Book 6.000 (https://github.com/silnrsi/font-padauk/releases/download/v6.000/PadaukBook-6.000.zip), and files of Unicodia's repository at a pinned commit (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mercury13/unicodia/df2b09c61e8fdc06f96fc6d6b194427f61bb2e38/Fonts/): Unicodia Funky 3.1.3, Daarage, Shafarik, and BabelStone Pseudographica 16.0.0
covers: every character of checks/font_characters.json a source font has, each in one of the fonts: the names, autonyms, and headings, the languages' other names, the orthographies' base, auxiliary, and mark characters, and the character sets'; and every character Glyph Compose's lists show (tools: its Glyph generation table's rows and what they are made of, its Diacritics tab's letters and their marks); not_covered lists the others
